_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9, the SHORT variation of ek-christian-telaviv (not a trim of it). Glasses POV only - the viewer is Tal the whole time. Different OPENING: the other, shorter take of the ask (video-5321) jump-cut to 'I don't have any money... I was wondering if you could help me with a piece of bread' -> 'Of course. Why bread? I can give you a pita'. Then 'We're Christians, we feed anyone that's in need' -> 'That's for you, my friend' -> Tal's confession heard on JOHNNY's face (V1 shows Tal) -> the 500 shekels -> snap onto his face on 'No' -> the refusal held ~11s -> 'You're more than welcome, my friend' -> slow-mo smile. Different ENDING: on his face, no pay-it-forward - so the 'one for someone who needs it' / 'give it to someone who needs it' lines are deliberately OUT (a promise this cut would not pay off). No Jewish/'almost the same' exchange, no making shot, no street. Same caption files, framing rules and capY as V1.
beats: OPEN (other take): Johnny comes to the counter - 'I don't have any money' (out in the 50ms dip before 'and')
THE ASK + THE YES on his face: 'I was wondering if you could help me with a piece of bread' / 'Of course... Why bread? I can give you a pita'
cut + 4-frame snap onto face and cross
WHO HE IS: 'We're Christians. We feed anyone that's in need'
the food: he turns with the pitas - 'That's for you, my friend'
THE REVEAL heard on HIS face, pitas still in his hands: 'Actually I want to be honest, I do have money'
the money counted out, camera rises to him: 'This is 500 shekels for you'
4-frame snap onto his face AS he says No
THE REFUSAL, HELD (~11s, one take): 'No, my friend. We don't do that. You ask for food, that's your food, my friend. No money involved' / 'Are you sure?' 'I'm very sure, my friend'
'Thank you so much' / 'You're more than welcome, my friend' - big smile
END on his face, SLOW-MO x0.5 (audio 51.17-51.97 has no words; 'Enjoy' starts 51.97)
